generator: tools/fx/gen_water.py (+ tools/fx/gen_water_fx.py for the fx sheets)

conventions.gspace: G = (screen x, 2 * screen y) world px = the iso ground plane seen from above (1 m = 64 G px). Water.js samples every texture with uv = G / tilePx (2:1 foreshortening like the ground). Image row 0 = v 0 = smallest G y.
conventions.data: water_waves_a / water_waves_b / water_foam / water_shore_ramp are DATA textures: plain RGB, no alpha, upload with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA false and UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION NONE, REPEAT + mipmaps (all power of two). water_lut is RGBA (A = opacity), CLAMP, no mipmaps.
conventions.module: src/systems/Water.js draws the sea with these (WebGL); Canvas fallback = ground/water_sea tileSprite.
conventions.levels: sea surface 0.55 m below land = waterPx 30 screen px (same as assets/harbor). Water.js heightAt() returns the swell height in screen px around that plane (+ = up).
conventions.fx: fx_* sheets: NORMAL-blend toy water art (white -> ice, thin sea-blue rim), frames left->right wrapped into rows <= 2048 px, Phaser anim key = sheet key; one-shots visible from frame 0, loops periodic. Generator: tools/fx/gen_water_fx.py

images.channels: R,G = ripple normal x,y in G space (0.5 + 0.5 n); B = caustics
images.notes: FFT (JONSWAP) ripple field, 8 m tile, peak 1.4 m; sample uv = G / 512.

images.channels: R,G = ripple normal x,y; B = caustics
images.notes: Fine ripple field, 3 m physical tile; Water.js samples it at 192 G px per tile.

images.channels: R = foam lace potential (threshold it), G = bubbles / slush bits, B = low-frequency variation
images.notes: Equalised lace: threshold t covers ~ (1 - t) of the area.

images.channels: RGB = water colour, A = opacity over the bed

images.notes: wet/dry ramps per shore material: u 0 = dry, 0.5 = fresh wet, 1 = under water.

spritesheets.notes: Spray burst of a swell crest hitting rock / a breakwater (foam mound, spray fan, mist, droplets). Anchor = impact point at the waterline. Water.js plays it at crest times on rock / breakwater shores (onCrash); scale 0.75-1.1.
Small splash (fish jump, pebble, swimmer kick). Anchor = water surface point.
Big splash (dive, cannonball, crate overboard): column, crown, droplets, mist, 3 rings. Anchor = water surface point.

Boat wake V for heading SE (bow arms at 19.5 deg + churned stern trail + transverse ripples), loop. Anchor = hull centre at the waterline, draw under the boat. Hull ~2.2 m: scale 1.15 rowboat, 2.0 fishing boat. Mirror (flipX) for SW.
Boat wake V, heading S (toward the camera).
Boat wake V, heading E (flipX for W).
Boat wake V, heading NE (flipX for NW).
Boat wake V, heading N (away from the camera).
Rings + lacy collar around a swimmer (loop). Anchor = waterline centre; draw UNDER the swimmer (depth = swimmer depth - 1). Clear centre ~32 x 14 px.
Sun glints twinkling on water (loop). Scatter a few over calm water (low quality / canvas).

Rolling breaking-wave strip for sand beaches, coast along world X, sea on the far (+Y, screen up-right) side. Chain one sprite every (+256, +128) px along the waterline; anchor = mean waterline at the segment centre. Seamless along the coast; 2.7 s loop, for beaches drawn WITHOUT the shader (canvas / fallback) - the shader draws its own swash on the 6 s shore swell.
Same for a coast along world Y with the sea on the far (-X, screen up-left) side (= flipX of _x). Chain every (+256, -128) px.
